question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Often
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Often"** means frequently or many times. (अक्सर)

 
 
• **Example: **She** often** goes for a walk in the evening.
 
 
 
• **"Rarely" **means not often; infrequently. (कभी-कभी)
 
 
• **Example: **He **rarely** goes out to eat.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'often' **is **'rarely'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Generally **(आम तौर पर): In most cases; usually.

 
 
• **Example**: **Generally,** he finishes his work by 5 PM.
 
 
 
• **Periodically **(समय-समय पर): From time to time; at intervals.
 
 
• **Example: **The company reviews its policies** periodically.**
 
 
 
• **Usually** (अमूमन): Under normal conditions; most of the time.
 
 
• **Example:** She** usually** takes the bus to work.
